description: This file provides utility functions for audio processing within the Pipecat project, including resampler creation, audio mixing, channel interleaving, volume calculation, audio conversions between formats (ulaw, alaw, PCM), silence detection, and other audio manipulations.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_default_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a deprecated default audio resampler instance; suggests using specific resampler creation functions.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_file_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates an audio resampler for batch processing of complete audio files.

methods.name: BaseAudioResampler create_stream_resampler(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a stream audio resampler for real-time processing.

methods.name: bytes mix_audio(audio1: bytes, audio2: bytes)
methods.description: Mixes two audio streams (bytes) by summing their samples with overflow protection.

methods.name: bytes interleave_stereo_audio(left_audio: bytes, right_audio: bytes)
methods.description: Interleaves two mono audio streams into a stereo stream.

methods.name: normalize_value(value, min_value, max_value)
methods.description: Normalizes a value within a given range to [0, 1] and clamps it.

methods.name: float calculate_audio_volume(audio: bytes, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Calculates the loudness of audio data using EBU R128 standard, normalized to [0, 1].

methods.name: float exp_smoothing(value: float, prev_value: float, factor: float)
methods.description: Applies exponential smoothing to a time-series value.

methods.name: ulaw_to_pcm( ulaw_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler )
methods.description: Converts μ-law encoded audio to PCM and resamples if necessary.

methods.name: pcm_to_ulaw(pcm_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler)
methods.description: Converts PCM audio to μ-law encoding with optional resampling.

methods.name: bytes alaw_to_pcm( alaw_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler )
methods.description: Converts A-law encoded audio to PCM with optional resampling.

methods.name: pcm_to_alaw(pcm_bytes: bytes, in_rate: int, out_rate: int, resampler: BaseAudioResampler)
methods.description: Converts PCM audio to A-law encoding with optional resampling.

methods.name: bool is_silence(pcm_bytes: bytes)
methods.description: Determines if raw PCM audio bytes are silent based on amplitude threshold.
